eyebrow.zh: 长程智能体 · 计划即合约 · 飞行中纠偏

headline.zh:
智能体跑偏了？
第 20 分钟就拦下，不是第 88 分钟
headline.en:
Your agent drifted from the plan.
Catch it at minute 20, not 88.

sub.zh: 把智能体公布的计划变成可对账的合约，实时对照它正在做的事，发现跑偏当场接受——把事后复盘变成第一手的飞行记录。
sub.en: Turn the agent's stated plan into a reconcilable contract, watch it against live execution, and accept drift on the spot — turning post-mortem discovery into a first-class in-flight record.

title.en: A plan you can hold it to

body.zh: 一条命令把智能体的计划变成带步骤和验收标准的版本化合约——它说过要做的事，白纸黑字，对得上账。
body.en: One command turns the agent's plan into a versioned contract with steps and acceptance criteria — what it said it would do, on the record and reconcilable.

body.zh: 智能体一边跑，你一边看：哪步对上了、哪步跑偏了、哪步没动、哪步多冒出来——都是实时的。
body.en: As the agent runs, watch live: which steps matched, which drifted, which never ran, which appeared out of nowhere — all in real time.

chips: › 已匹配 / 跑偏 / 未执行 / 多余

body.zh: 按一下 a 键接受跑偏的步骤，账本记成一条版本化记录——接受是第一手的，不是悄悄覆写过去。
body.en: Press a to accept a drifted step and the ledger records it as a versioned entry — acceptance is first-class, never a silent overwrite.

body.zh: 对账靠步骤在不在、验收关键词对不对——确定性的，不靠另一个大模型打分。所以一个周末能搭起来，而且全程可审计。
body.en: Matching is step-presence and keyword acceptance-criteria — deterministic, not another model scoring it. So it builds in a weekend and stays fully auditable.

headline.en: Turn drift into a flight record

sub.zh: 一条命令装上，给长程智能体配上可对账的计划合约。
sub.en: Install in one command — give your long-horizon agent a reconcilable plan contract.

tag.zh: 长程智能体的飞行记录仪
tag.en: The flight recorder for long-horizon agents
